cond_0001.intro:
As a Lead R&D Fuel Cell Scientist, you will work closely with a diverse team of scientists, engineers, and technicians to develop and commercialize high-performance fuel cell power generation technologies for unmanned systems (air, ground, and underwater vehicles).
The ideal candidate has a solid understanding of the design and development of fuel cell systems and demonstrates aptitude for the integration of complex electrochemical, electronics, software, thermal, and packaging technologies into prototypes and manufacturable products that delight customers. Technical curiosity, passion for winning, and a hands-on approach to problem-solving are highly sought-after traits for this position.
You will lead technology maturity projects, coordinate across multiple organizations, and build deep technical knowledge of fuel cell systems and platform integrations. You will participate in developing new concepts and writing proposals to government funding agencies to secure project funding. You will work in an Agile (Scrum) environment to solve complex problems with speed and creativity. This role reports to the Advanced Alternative Power team within [Company name masked] Aerospace Advanced & Applied Technology organization.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Lead small teams in the design and development of next generation fuel cell stacks and power systems and their integration with unmanned systems (air, ground, and underwater vehicles)
Act as a fuel cell technology leader within [Company name masked] Advanced and Applied Technology, championing technologies from initial concept through product launch
Integrate with existing project teams and university partners to drive development of key technologies through early design through multiple prototyping cycles
Work directly with sponsors and customers to understand and formulate their technical requirements and business needs into achievable technology and product roadmaps
Support and frequently interact with stakeholders inside and outside work area
Manage and understand complex customer requirements
Negotiate with customers, partners and subcontractors on requirements and design parameters
Transform customer requirements into innovative prototypes based on creative design and fabrication technique
Work on assignments that are complex in nature and where judgment and initiative is required
Solve complex problems through analysis and innovation; solutions may become part of standard operating procedure
Be available for travel up to 10%
cond_0001.requirements:
U.S. Person Requirements
Due to compliance with U.S. Export control laws and regulations, candidate must be a U.S. Person, which is defined as, a U.S. Citizen, a U.S. Permanent resident, or have protected status in the U.S. Under asylum or refugee status or have the ability to obtain an export authorization
Minimum Requirements
10+ Years of engineering experience in an R&D environment
5+ Years of experience with power and energy devices or systems (e.g., fuel cells, batteries, energy harvesting, power/energy systems) with strong understanding of PEM fuel cell technologies including MEAs, cells, stacks, BOP components, and systems
Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution in a technical discipline such as the sciences, technology, engineering or mathematics
Breadth and depth of experience designing and building prototype systems that integrate diverse component technologies
Strong analytical skills and an excellent understanding of basic physics
Strong self-motivation/direction, entrepreneurial mind-set, and teaming skills
Clear and concise written and verbal communication skills
Strong project management skills to create and maintain programmatic and technical documentation
Proficiency in analyzing experimental data using standard software tools (e.g., Excel, MATLAB, Python, R, etc.)
Preferred Requirements
MS or PhD in physics, engineering, material science, or related degree program
Strong understanding of small, unmanned vehicle platforms and power system integration
Experience developing groundbreaking new ideas, writing proposals to government customers (e.g., DARPA, IARPA, DoE), winning/providing technical leadership to execute contracts
Experience with CAD tools such as: CREO (ProE), MasterCAM, Solidworks, NX

The ideal candidate has a solid understanding of the design and development of fuel cell systems and demonstrates aptitude for the integration of complex electrochemical, electronics, software, thermal, and packaging technologies into prototypes and manufacturable products that delight customers. Technical curiosity, passion for winning, and a hands-on approach to problem-solving are highly sought-after traits for this position.
You will lead technology maturity projects, coordinate across multiple organizations, and build deep technical knowledge of fuel cell systems and platform integrations. You will participate in developing new concepts and writing proposals to government funding agencies to secure project funding. You will work in an Agile (Scrum) environment to solve complex problems with speed and creativity. This role reports to the Advanced Alternative Power team within [Company name masked] Aerospace Advanced & Applied Technology organization.
cond_0290.responsibilities:
Lead small teams in the design and development of next generation fuel cell stacks and power systems and their integration with unmanned systems (air, ground, and underwater vehicles)
Act as a fuel cell technology leader within [Company name masked] Advanced and Applied Technology, championing technologies from initial concept through product launch
Integrate with existing project teams and university partners to drive development of key technologies through early design through multiple prototyping cycles
Work directly with sponsors and customers to understand and formulate their technical requirements and business needs into achievable technology and product roadmaps
Support and frequently interact with stakeholders inside and outside work area
Manage and understand complex customer requirements
Negotiate with customers, partners and subcontractors on requirements and design parameters
Transform customer requirements into innovative prototypes based on creative design and fabrication technique
Work on assignments that are complex in nature and where judgment and initiative is required
Solve complex problems through analysis and innovation; solutions may become part of standard operating procedure
Be available for travel up to 10%
cond_0290.requirements:
Due to compliance with U.S. Export control laws and regulations, candidate must be a U.S. Person, which is defined as, a U.S. Citizen, a U.S. Permanent resident, or have protected status in the U.S. Under asylum or refugee status or have the ability to obtain an export authorization.
Minimum Requirements
Minimum 10 years of demonstrated expertise in engineering within an R&D environment
Minimum 5 years of proven expertise with power and energy devices or systems (e.g., fuel cells, batteries, energy harvesting, power/energy systems) with advanced knowledge of PEM fuel cell technologies including MEAs, cells, stacks, BOP components, and systems
Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution in a technical discipline such as the sciences, technology, engineering, or mathematics; advanced degree strongly preferred
Substantial breadth and depth of experience designing and building prototype systems that integrate diverse component technologies
Advanced knowledge of small, unmanned vehicle platforms and power system integration
Exceptional analytical skills and deep understanding of basic physics
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills
Strong project management skills with a proven ability to create and maintain programmatic and technical documentation
Proficiency in analyzing experimental data using standard software tools (e.g., Excel, MATLAB, Python, R, etc.)
Preferred Requirements
MS or PhD in physics, engineering, material science, or related field
Proven track record developing groundbreaking new ideas, writing proposals to government customers (e.g., DARPA, IARPA, DoE), and providing technical leadership to execute contracts
Strong self-motivation, entrepreneurial mindset, and teaming abilities

cond_0357.intro:
We are looking for a Lead R&D Fuel Cell Scientist to join our team.

The ideal candidate has a solid understanding of the design and development of fuel cell systems and demonstrates aptitude for the integration of complex electrochemical, electronics, software, thermal, and packaging technologies into prototypes and manufacturable products. Technical curiosity, a drive to win, and a hands-on approach to problem-solving are highly sought-after traits for this position.
You will lead technology maturity projects, direct coordination across multiple organizations, and build deep technical knowledge of fuel cell systems and platform integrations. You will take the lead in developing new concepts and writing proposals to government funding agencies to secure project funding. You will execute complex problem-solving with speed and creativity in an Agile (Scrum) environment. This role reports to the Advanced Alternative Power team within [Company name masked] Aerospace Advanced & Applied Technology organization.
cond_0440.responsibilities:
Lead small teams in the design and development of next generation fuel cell stacks and power systems and their integration with unmanned systems (air, ground, and underwater vehicles)
Own the fuel cell technology leadership role within [Company name masked] Advanced and Applied Technology, driving technologies from initial concept through product launch
Direct integration with existing project teams and university partners to advance key technologies through early design and multiple prototyping cycles
Engage directly with sponsors and customers to understand and translate their technical requirements and business needs into achievable technology and product roadmaps
Own stakeholder engagement inside and outside the work area
Manage and resolve complex customer requirements
Lead negotiations with customers, partners, and subcontractors on requirements and design parameters
Execute the transformation of customer requirements into innovative prototypes through creative design and fabrication techniques
Take on assignments that are complex in nature and where judgment and initiative are required
Solve complex problems through analysis and innovation; solutions may become part of standard operating procedure
Available for travel up to 10%
cond_0440.requirements:

Minimum Requirements
10+ Years of engineering experience in an R&D environment
5+ Years of experience with power and energy devices or systems (e.g., fuel cells, batteries, energy harvesting, power/energy systems) with strong understanding of PEM fuel cell technologies including MEAs, cells, stacks, BOP components, and systems
Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution in a technical discipline such as the sciences, technology, engineering, or mathematics
MS or PhD in physics, engineering, material science, or related degree program
Breadth and depth of experience designing and building prototype systems that integrate diverse component technologies
Strong analytical skills and an excellent understanding of basic physics
Strong self-motivation/direction, entrepreneurial mind-set, and teaming skills
Clear and concise written and verbal communication skills
Strong project management skills to create and maintain programmatic and technical documentation
Preferred Requirements
Strong understanding of small, unmanned vehicle platforms and power system integration
Experience developing new ideas and writing proposals to government customers (e.g., DARPA, IARPA, DoE), and providing technical leadership to execute contracts

cond_0465.intro:
We are looking for a Lead R&D Fuel Cell Scientist to join our team.
In this role, you will work closely and regularly with a diverse team of scientists, engineers, and technicians to develop and commercialize high-performance fuel cell power generation technologies for unmanned systems (air, ground, and underwater vehicles).
A large part of the role is staying in contact with multiple organizations, sponsors, and university partners, coordinating across groups and communicating progress.
